name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Infused Preroll | Bubblegum Gelato
description:
Infused with terpene-rich live resin and rolled with premium indica flower, this 1.2G pre-roll delivers amplified potency with sweet dessert-style flavor. Built for strong body effects, heavy smoke output, and premium infused appeal.

Strain: Bubblegum Gelato (Indica)

Infusion: Full-spectrum Live Resin

Total Weight: 1.2g

Aroma: Sweet bubblegum candy, creamy vanilla, light earthy gas

Flavor: Sugary candy inhale with smooth creamy finish and subtle diesel undertone

Effects: Relaxing body melt, mellow euphoria, calming night-time vibe

Experience: Thick smoke output, slow even burn, intensified terpene punch
